ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for the EOL Oak Brook EdM & CAS cohort that began Summer 2009. Class sessions will be held at the Oak Brook Multi-University Center on the following weekends: August 28 and 29, September 18 and 19, October 16 and 17 and December 4 and 5. Friday classes will run from 5:30 to 9:30 PM and Saturday sessions from 8 AM to 5 PM. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
